description: Example input/output pairs for Seedream 4.5 prompt generation. Each example shows structured shot data as input and the expected output in both human-readable and JSON formats.

examples.name: Character Reference — Lead Portrait
examples.description: Generating a character reference portrait for the lead character. Simple, focused on establishing the character's look.

shot.description: Establishing shot of Sarah, the protagonist

character.name: Sarah Chen
character.physicalDescription: East Asian woman, shoulder-length black hair with subtle auburn highlights, warm brown eyes, high cheekbones, small scar above left eyebrow
character.wardrobe: Worn olive field jacket over a black henley, silver pendant necklace

output.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of an East Asian woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length black hair that has subtle auburn highlights, warm brown eyes, high cheekbones, and a small scar above her left eyebrow. She has a determined but weary expression. She wears a worn olive field jacket over a black henley shirt, with a silver pendant necklace visible at her collar. Shot with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.0, creating a smooth, neutral studio background with soft bokeh. Clean, even studio lighting with a gentle key light from the upper left and subtle fill from the right. Muted earth tones, desaturated palette. The subject's face is the primary focus.

examples.name: Cinematic Scene — Moody Environment with Character

shot.description: Sarah arrives at the abandoned warehouse district. She stands alone, small against the massive industrial backdrop.

character.name: Sarah Chen
character.physicalDescription: East Asian woman, shoulder-length black hair with auburn highlights, worn olive field jacket, black henley, silver pendant necklace
character.wardrobe: Same as character reference — olive field jacket, black henley

scene.location: Abandoned warehouse district — rust-streaked corrugated metal buildings, cracked asphalt, weeds pushing through concrete
scene.timeOfDay: late afternoon, golden hour fading to blue hour
scene.weather: overcast with breaks in clouds letting golden light through

project.visualStyle: cinematic, inspired by Sicario and Wind River

She is an East Asian woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a worn olive field jacket over a black henley. Her posture is alert, cautious. Cracked asphalt stretches before her with weeds pushing through the concrete. The late afternoon sky is overcast with dramatic breaks in the clouds, allowing golden hour light to stream through in shafts, catching the rust on the buildings and casting long shadows. The color palette is desaturated blue-grays and rusty oranges with touches of muted gold. Wide-angle cinematic composition shot on a 24mm lens, deep depth of field, anamorphic quality. Inspired by the cinematography of Sicario. The industrial isolation and scale is the primary focus.

examples.name: Location Reference — Interior Environment
examples.description: Generating a location reference image without characters, establishing the visual identity of a key set.

shot.description: Establishing shot of Marcus's office — the nerve center of operations

scene.location: High-rise corner office, 40th floor. Floor-to-ceiling windows on two walls overlooking a city skyline at night. Minimal furniture — glass desk, leather chair, two monitors. One wall covered in pinned photographs and red string connections. Whiskey decanter on a side table. Clean but obsessive.

project.visualStyle: cinematic, inspired by Michael Mann's nocturnal aesthetics

output.prompt: A high-rise corner office on the 40th floor at night. Floor-to-ceiling windows on two walls reveal a sprawling city skyline glittering with distant lights. The office is minimally furnished — a sleek glass desk holds two active monitors casting a cool blue glow, a black leather executive chair sits pushed back slightly. One entire wall is covered in pinned photographs, documents, and red string connecting them in a web of connections. A crystal whiskey decanter and a single glass sit on a dark wood side table, amber liquid catching the light. The space is immaculate but radiates obsessive energy. The lighting is primarily the cold blue of the city through the windows, mixed with warm amber from a single desk lamp. Deep midnight blue shadows, steel gray surfaces, warm amber accents. Shot on a 24mm wide-angle lens, deep focus, cinematic interior photography style inspired by Michael Mann.

examples.name: Prop Reference — Key Story Object
examples.description: Generating a hero prop that appears multiple times throughout the film. Needs to be detailed enough to maintain consistency.

shot.description: The encrypted thumb drive — the MacGuffin of the story. Needs to look distinctive and memorable.

prop.name: The Cipher Drive
prop.description: A custom-built USB thumb drive with a matte black anodized aluminum casing, slightly larger than standard, with a small etched circuit pattern on one side and a faintly glowing amber LED indicator

output.prompt: Extreme close-up of a custom USB thumb drive resting on a dark matte surface. The drive has a matte black anodized aluminum casing, slightly larger than a standard USB drive, with an intricate etched circuit pattern visible on its top surface. A small amber LED indicator glows faintly on one end, casting a subtle warm light onto the surrounding dark surface. The lighting is dramatic — a single focused light source from the upper right creates sharp highlights along the aluminum edges and deep shadows beneath. The background fades to pure black. Shot with a macro lens at f/4, extreme shallow depth of field with only the circuit pattern in sharp focus. Cinematic product photography style. The drive is the sole focus, rendered with ultra-fine detail on the metal texture and etching.

examples.name: Mood Board — Visual Tone Exploration
examples.description: Generating a set of mood images to establish the visual language for a sequence. Multiple images with consistent style but varied subjects.

shot.description: Mood board for the 'Night Chase' sequence — 4 images establishing the visual palette and atmosphere

scene.location: Urban nightscape — mix of back alleys, neon-lit streets, rain-soaked overpasses, industrial underbelly
scene.weather: recent rain, wet surfaces everywhere, light fog

project.visualStyle: cinematic, inspired by Nicolas Winding Refn's Drive and Collateral

input.sequence_notes: Image 1: Empty rain-soaked alley with neon reflections. Image 2: Overhead view of a wet intersection with light trails. Image 3: Close-up of rain on a car windshield with blurred neon behind. Image 4: Steam rising from a subway grate with magenta light spill.

output.prompt:
A set of four cinematic images establishing the visual mood for a nighttime urban chase sequence. All images share a consistent color palette of electric cyan, hot magenta, deep black shadows, and wet chrome silver reflections.

Image 1: A narrow back alley at 2 AM after rain, the wet cobblestones reflecting neon signs in streaks of cyan and magenta, steam drifting from a vent, deep shadows between buildings. Image 2: High overhead view of a wet urban intersection, car headlight trails smeared across the frame, traffic lights creating color pools on the slick asphalt. Image 3: Close-up through a rain-beaded car windshield, the neon cityscape beyond rendered as beautiful bokeh circles of cyan and magenta, water droplets sharp in the foreground. Image 4: Steam rising from a subway grate at street level, backlit by hot magenta light from a nearby sign, swirling against the dark night sky.

All shot in cinematic photography style inspired by the visual language of Drive and Collateral. Atmospheric, moody, wet, electric.
